templates.title: AI Marketplace Monitor
templates.name: ai-marketplace-monitor
templates.description: Watch Facebook Marketplace for the items you want, rate each new listing with AI, and get notified of good deals. Source: https://github.com/BoPeng/ai-marketplace-monitor
templates.note: Open the web UI on port 8467 and sign in with the Facebook username and password you entered here. If Facebook asks for a CAPTCHA or a security code, click Open browser in the web UI. The default configuration needs a UnitySVC API key. Config, cache and logs live in the named volume mounted at /data. See the Docker installation guide.

env.name: FACEBOOK_USERNAME
env.label: Facebook username (required)
env.description: The Facebook account aimm logs in with. Also signs you in to the web UI.

env.name: FACEBOOK_PASSWORD
env.label: Facebook password (required)
env.description: Password of that Facebook account. Also signs you in to the web UI.

env.name: UNITYSVC_API_KEY
env.label: UnitySVC API key
env.description: For the default configuration: the AI that rates listings, and email and phone notifications. Replace the placeholder with your key; with the placeholder, aimm searches but cannot rate listings or send notifications until you set a key here or other AI and notification services in the web UI.

env.name: TZ
env.label: Time zone
env.description: For the daily digest, e.g. America/Chicago.

env.name: AIMM_WEBUI_AUTH
env.label: Web UI sign-in
env.description: Who signs you in to the web UI. local needs the web UI password below. Behind a reverse proxy that signs users in, see the Docker installation guide for the variables each mode needs.

select.text: aimm, with the Facebook username and password
aimm, with the web UI username and password below

env.name: AIMM_WEBUI_USERNAME
env.label: Web UI username
env.description: With local sign-in: the username of the web UI.

env.name: AIMM_WEBUI_PASSWORD
env.label: Web UI password
env.description: With local sign-in (required): the password of the web UI, unrelated to the Facebook password.
